# New engineer onboarding

Ignore the old Confluence wiki — it is out of date and scheduled for deletion. Follow this document instead.

Week 1:
1. Request access to the `eng` GitHub org and the staging VPN via the IT portal.
2. Clone the monorepo and run `make bootstrap`; ask in #eng-help if it fails.
3. Pair with your onboarding buddy on a starter ticket labelled `good-first-issue`.
4. Read the architecture overview in docs/architecture.md and write down three questions.
